description: The crypto material model contains information on the set of cryptographic materials associated with a unique instance of a serialized part or just-in-sequence part, such as e.g, an Electronic Control Unit (ECU).

UuidV4Trait.description: The provided regular expression ensures that the UUID is composed of five groups of characters separated by hyphens, in the form 8-4-4-4-12 for a total of 36 characters (32 hexadecimal characters and 4 hyphens), optionally prefixed by "urn:uuid:" to make it an IRI.

NameCharacteristic.description: String containing the name assigned to cryptographic material.

TypeEnumeration.description: Enumeration defining the allowed types of cryptographic material.

ValueCharacteristic.description: String containing the textual representation the value of cryptographic material in the format and encoding specified in the respective properties.

FormatEnumeration.description: Enumeration defining the allowed formats for cryptographic material.

EncodingEnumeration.description: Enumeration defining the allowed encodings for cryptographic material.

CryptoMaterialEntity.description: Entity containing information describing an instance of cryptographic material.

name.description:
Name assigned to the cryptographic material.

This property may be used to indicate the security service  provided by the cryptographic material and the usage or application it is associated with.

type.description:
Type of cryptographic material.

Provided cryptographic material must have one of the following types:
- symmetric key
- private key
- public key
- digital certificate
- certificate signing request
- secret material

value.description: Value of cryptographic material in the format and encoding specified in the respective properties.

format.description:
Format of cryptographic material.

Provided cryptographic material must have one of the following formats:
- PKCS#1
- PKCS#8
- PKCS#10
- raw
- subjectPublicKeyInfo
- X.509v3

encoding.description:
Encoding of cryptographic material.

Provided cryptographic material must have one of the following encodings:
- Base64
- HEX
- RFC 7468

CryptoMaterialsSet.description: Set containing instances of cryptographic material.

globalAssetId.description: The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.

cryptoMaterials.description: Set of one or more instances of cryptographic material associated with a unique instance of a serialized part or just-in-sequence part.
